## Summary

Describe the problem and the change that solves it.

## Testing

List the commands and manual scenarios used to verify the change.

## User Interface

Include screenshots or recordings for visible changes, or write "Not applicable."

## Checklist

- [ ] I created this change on a `feat/`, `fix/`, or `chore/` branch in my fork.
- [ ] I kept the change focused and excluded generated build or release artifacts.
- [ ] I added or updated tests for changed behavior.
- [ ] I ran the relevant tests locally.
- [ ] I updated documentation where needed.
- [ ] I agree to contribute this work under `GPL-3.0-or-later`.
